title: Portuguese Custard Tarta
description: A classic Portuguese dessert featuring a flaky torta crust filled with creamy custard.
instructions: Roll out the torta crust and place in a baking dish.
In a large bowl, whisk together the sugar, eggs, flour, and melted butter.
Add the zesty lemon zest, vanilla extract, and salt to the bowl and whisk until combined.
Pour the custard mixture into the torta crust.
Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the custard is set.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Optional: top with fresh fruit or whipped cream.
